name: Hypnosis App!
detailed_description:
■STORY■

She is everybody's darling.

Popular, drop-dead gorgeous, and that killer body? Out of this world!

Tons of guys have taken their shot with her. All shot down, naturally.

Me? I wouldn't dare dream of asking her out.

Even if it's just a wet dream, let me have her once…

I'm just lusting after her body! I've been secretly obsessed with her!

One day, I woke up horny and found a strange app installed on my phone…

Is it…the rumored "Hypnosis App"?

This is getting interesting…

■GAME PLAY■

Hypnosis Training Simulation Game
※The game story is all based on the male protagonist's perspect.

Chatting with people, gathering information during the day.
Training Erina in the immersive night dream.
Avoiding nightmare occurred and keeping Erina's affection level!

Earn magic points and pay tribute to the apostle.
Increase your ability by unlocking all Special Power!
Confession failed?
Consume your magic points and turn back the clock.
You can activate new game plus and restart your challenge!

■CHARACTER■

Kamiya Erina

The famous Gyaru idol in town.
Good personality, impressive figure, she is many people's sexual fantasy.
However, she seems to have something on her mind lately…

Lise The Apostle

Apostle of "The Lord of Lust", who created the "Hypnosis App" and immersive dream.
She is fully mystic, looked green around the gills.
It seems like she can get some "goods" from sexual intercourse.
